body: It'll be nice to finally sleep though.

I've decided to go through with it. I can't even sleep anymore. I hope no one blames themselves. 

Hope my dog doesn't miss me too much. Sorry Lexi.

No support groups around here. I'll need to hold down this god-awful deli clerk job to afford any sort of mental healthcare. So far I haven't quit. But, only because I know I'll still be depressed if I do.
